videos.title: Why some birds gave up flight | Steve Brusatte #shorts #science #birdevolution #dinosaurs #birds
videos.author: The Royal Institution
videos.description:
The cassowary... also known as the dinosaur that forgot to die. Steve Brusatte's full talk covers how we discovered the link between birds and dinosaurs, and then the science behind why our birds today are in fact surviving dinosaurs.
